scope: SDevice-only frozen-state contact-cut current attribution and residual-spectrum analysis

contact_cut_definition.rule: a finite-volume edge with exactly one endpoint in the named contact node set
contact_cut_definition.orientation: positive edge sign when node0 belongs to the contact, negative when node1 belongs
contact_cut_definition.terminal_identity: sum of signed contact-cut SG line fluxes

h1.statement: The active-edge mobility improvement is concentrated away from source and drain contact cuts, so frozen-state terminal current is insensitive to the drive substitution.
h1.decision_rule: all 16 states must satisfy the threshold and the drain-cut replay identity

conditioning.interpretation_guard: large kappa proves sensitivity to component errors but does not by itself close the observed terminal-current error

continuity_scope.frozen_state: report the source plus drain plus substrate contact-flux imbalance without claiming self-consistent SRH closure
continuity_scope.self_consistent_context: reuse M8 deep-off SRH and four-terminal KCL diagnostics only as separately labelled context
